I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I told her I can't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I couldn't find anything to check it against. There's no Brackenwater account folder, contract or CRM record in the files she can see, and nobody has mentioned Brackenwater in #central-team before. I suggested she treat the date as unconfirmed until it shows up in the contract or order form, or Brackenwater puts it in writing, and that the account owner is the right person to confirm it.

I didn't record the date anywhere, and no approval was needed.
